posts.author: ShadowDragon
posts.body:
bust prio = 0  is behind while 1 is in front
bust pos = 0 above message window, 1 on bottom of the screen.
so you mainly have a position of the 2 and set it on the right side or left side.
this is also shown in the demo.
bust prio seems to reset to 0 if bust pos = 0, not sure why.
but there is not a position to place on the screen location.
I don't know if there are plugins already doing what you want.
but unsure how to modify the plugin to do what you want.
so the best way is to have an advance coder make a mod for it or help you out.
